age_estimator_notes.fay: no independently reported release volume. Deriving V from area_km2 x a thickness class -- as the brief suggests -- is circular, because the observed area then appears on both sides of the spreading law. Pass --volume-m3 from the official finding (e.g. Huntington: 588 barrels = 93.5 m3, NTSB MIR-24-01).
age_estimator_notes.elongation: implied age 234.6 h is past the 72 h ceiling -- the shear rate is too small to have produced this elongation within any timescale we model
age_estimator_notes.mixture: discharge_class was 'unknown' (elongation 4.13 falls between the acute and chronic bands). Both hypotheses independently cleared the information floor, so they were mixed in proportion to how much each moved the prior on its own: patch 37%, track 63%.
